short_description: Low light levels on DFW metro ring
description: Optical receive power dropped 6 dB on two ring nodes. Splice enclosure may be water-damaged after last night's storm.

short_description: Backhoe dig-in reported near Houston splice point
description: Field tech reports a construction crew hit buried conduit. Multiple enterprise circuits down in Houston east.

short_description: Wave down on Dallas-Miami long-haul
description: 100G wave alarming LOS since 04:10. Protection switch did not trigger.

short_description: Rodent damage suspected on aerial cable in Tampa
description: Intermittent loss on aerial cable between two poles. Chew marks were found on the last patrol.

short_description: Dropped calls at Atlanta downtown site
description: VoLTE drop rate at 3.4%. Radio alarms on sector 2.

short_description: Tower on generator after storm in rural Oklahoma
description: Cell tower lost commercial power and is running on generator with fuel at 20%. Coverage will drop if the generator fails.

short_description: 5G standalone attach failures in Phoenix
description: Subscribers cannot attach to 5G SA and are falling back to LTE across the metro.

short_description: Antenna tilt misconfigured after site upgrade
description: Coverage complaints near the stadium after a remote electrical tilt change on three sectors.

short_description: BGP session down with IX peering partner
description: eBGP session to the IX peer has been idle since maintenance. About 12k prefixes withdrawn.

short_description: SIP trunk failures for enterprise voice customers
description: Inbound calls failing with 503 responses on SIP trunks in the Atlanta region.

short_description: Packet loss on backbone between Denver and Kansas City
description: MPLS LSPs rerouting repeatedly. Latency up 40 ms on the backbone path.

short_description: Invoice generation timing out
description: Monthly invoice batch jobs failing with timeouts since this morning.

short_description: Mobile app login errors after release
description: Customers see 'something went wrong' when logging into the myAccount app after version 8.2.

short_description: Payment page returning 502 errors
description: Checkout on the website returns 502 intermittently. The payment provider status page shows healthy.

short_description: HR onboarding cases not syncing
description: New hire cases are stuck in the queue. Integration logs show authentication failures.

short_description: ServiceNow approval workflow stuck
description: Change requests are stuck at the approval step since the last workflow update.

short_description: CMDB discovery missing new servers
description: The discovery job completed but 40 new servers were not added to the CMDB.

short_description: Azure AD sign-in failures for employees
description: Staff cannot sign into internal apps. A conditional access policy was changed yesterday.

short_description: Kubernetes nodes not ready in East US
description: AKS node pool shows NotReady after an OS upgrade. Pods are stuck pending.

short_description: Subscription quota reached in landing zone
description: Deployments failing because the vCPU quota is exceeded in the landing zone subscription.
